note: video_embed_facebook adds ONE Video Embed Field provider plugin (class Facebook, @VideoEmbedProvider id='facebook') for the video_embed_field module. Recognised URLs: https://www.facebook.com/<page>/videos/<id> and https://www.facebook.com/video.php?v=<id>; embed iframe -> https://www.facebook.com/plugins/video.php?href=<url>; thumbnail -> https://graph.facebook.com/<id>/picture. No config/permissions/Drush/own plugin types. ENVIRONMENT NOTE: on this site Facebook::renderEmbedCode($width,$height,$autoplay) is incompatible with the installed ProviderPluginBase::renderEmbedCode($width,$height,$autoplay,$title_format=NULL,$use_title_fallback=TRUE), so LOADING the provider class fatals; storing/reading a Facebook URL in a video_embed_field works but rendering/provider-resolution does not. Therefore medium cases inspect the stored raw URL value, and hard verify checks the stored value against the facebook URL pattern WITHOUT loading the provider class.

evals.prompt: Which Facebook video URL formats does the video_embed_facebook provider recognise for a Video Embed Field?
evals.expected_output: It recognises https://www.facebook.com/<page>/videos/<id> and https://www.facebook.com/video.php?v=<id> (with or without www.); getIdFromInput() extracts the numeric <id> from either.

evals.prompt: How does video_embed_facebook integrate with Drupal — what kind of plugin is it and which module must it work with?
evals.expected_output: It is a single Video Embed Field provider plugin: class Facebook annotated @VideoEmbedProvider(id = "facebook") extending ProviderPluginBase, and it depends on the video_embed_field module. Enabling it makes any video_embed_field field accept Facebook URLs; there is no separate configuration.

evals.prompt: When video_embed_facebook renders a Facebook video, what iframe URL does it embed, and where does it get the video thumbnail from?
evals.expected_output: renderEmbedCode() emits a video_embed_iframe pointing at https://www.facebook.com/plugins/video.php?href=<url> (with autoplay and show_text=0); getRemoteThumbnailUrl() returns https://graph.facebook.com/<id>/picture for the thumbnail.

evals.prompt: On this site, the Article 'vef_known' has a Video Embed Field (field_vef_known) holding a Facebook video. Inspect the stored value and tell me the Facebook video id.
evals.expected_output: field_vef_known stores https://www.facebook.com/somepage/videos/9876543210 — the Facebook video id is 9876543210 (the trailing numeric segment after /videos/).

evals.prompt: The Article 'vef_alt' on this site stores a Facebook video in the Video Embed Field field_vef_alt using the video.php URL form. Inspect the stored value and give the Facebook video id.
evals.expected_output: field_vef_alt stores https://www.facebook.com/video.php?v=1234567890 — the video id is 1234567890 (the v= query value).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, add a Video Embed Field named field_vef_task to the Article content type (so it can hold Facebook videos via video_embed_facebook), then create an Article titled 'vef_task' whose field_vef_task contains the Facebook video https://www.facebook.com/somepage/videos/9876543210. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: A field storage/instance field_vef_task of type video_embed_field exists on node.article, and an Article 'vef_task' stores a facebook.com video URL (e.g. https://www.facebook.com/somepage/videos/9876543210) in it.

evals.prompt: My Article pages already have a video field called field_vef_show. Please add a new Article titled 'vef_show' that embeds this Facebook video: https://www.facebook.com/video.php?v=555000111
evals.expected_output: An Article 'vef_show' stores https://www.facebook.com/video.php?v=555000111 (facebook.com URL containing id 555000111) in the video_embed_field field_vef_show.
